title: 2496. Maximum Value of a String in an Array

examples.explanation: - "alic3" consists of both letters and digits, so its value is its length, i.e. 5. - "bob" consists only of letters, so its value is also its length, i.e. 3. - "3" consists only of digits, so its value is its numeric equivalent, i.e. 3. - "4" also consists only of digits, so its value is 4. - "00000" consists only of digits, so its value is 0. Hence, the maximum value is 5, of "alic3".
Each string in the array has value 1. Hence, we return 1.
